questions.q: Which principle of design concerns the relationship of the size of one part of an object to another part, or to the whole object?
questions.explain: Proportion deals with the size relationships between various parts of an artwork. It assesses how the scale of one element compares to the scale of other elements within the composition.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Art Fundamentals & Elements of Design
questions.subject: Arts

questions.q: If an artist draws a human figure where the head is half the size of the entire body, this figure looks strange because it violates the rules of:
questions.explain: The human body has natural proportions (e.g., the average adult body is about 7 to 8 heads tall). A head drawn too large for a body shows a distortion or violation of proper Proportion.
